name: Madeira caiada
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square opaque material tile for the visible TOP surface of a medieval fantasy battlemap WALL. Camera exactly vertically above at 90 degrees, orthographic, absolutely no side view or perspective. Finely hand-painted realistic game art matching natural timber, plaster and stone from a detailed overhead VTT library. Small-scale crisp grain, restrained natural colors, even neutral overhead lighting across the whole tile, no cast shadows or vignette. Fill every pixel edge-to-edge with the same continuous material. Seamless repeat across all four edges. No wall silhouette, room, corner, frame, floor, furniture, characters, objects, text, watermark, grid or transparent margin. Material: whitewashed old timber, horizontal grain, worn warm ivory lime paint revealing pale wood.
